prior_failures_and_fixes: Before policy change, five live cases used explicit parsed-constraint review, including a real ID 200 beyond the first 50 products. Latest UI removes that review.
Initial alternative experiment produced unsupported refund/top-up advice; application-generated purchase checks replace model policy assertions.

A live run incorrectly treated original-scope zero as alternative-scope evidence. Current model input isolates query history by scope and explicitly requires searching an unqueried scope; three final live cases passed.
final_source_delta: After live fixture creation, UI copy and purchase-checklist long-spec truncation were finalized. Model inputs, queries and product selections unchanged; production-function synthetic checks include long-spec output bounds.

public_backend_probe.conclusion: New tool interface not yet deployed; source push is not deployment.

limitations: Natural-language interpretation can be mistaken; unsupported attributes explicitly unverified.
Backend filters prove absence under executable filters, not arbitrary unsupported requirements.
Fresh stock/price/description check before adoption is synthetic-verified; no orders created by these read-only live probes.
